answer: The meadow holds work receipts rather than names, so the willow of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reset on any identity-link attempt. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lotus of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
